exact_incumbents.claim: QGO markets one China-side execution team for overseas buyers/B2B partners, multi-city routing and factory visits; it explicitly offers partner-safe white-label delivery and wholesale execution quotes while the partner retains the client relationship.
ChinaLocalAgent offers one-time, short-term and ongoing China-side support for overseas clients and coordinates clearly scoped local execution with evidence/reporting.
China Biz Agent states that it provides international clients local hands/eyes and can execute across mainland China rather than only a few hubs.
FactoryPass directly sells buyer-paid supplier verification and live factory visits with bilingual China field representatives across major manufacturing clusters and custom coverage elsewhere.
Domestic network already standardizes point/location/evidence/acceptance, local-person matching and QA at large scale.

why: The proposed scope-normalization, local-team routing, evidence/reporting and one-China-side-point-of-contact functions are already marketed as incumbent services.
QGO's explicit B2B partner/white-label/wholesale execution proposition is especially close to the proposed Demand-Pump-to-China-coverage orchestration role.
A low-cost/API/batch cross-border variant remains imaginable but is not independently evidenced as a recurring missing edge; inventing it would violate fail-closed promotion.
Current live gigs therefore prove money and task recurrence but do not establish a distinct operator-controlled bridge.
next_boundary: Search cross-border physical-world flows for residual state transitions not already packaged by China local agents, B2B white-label visit coordinators, professional inspectors, marketplaces or domestic field-task networks. Do not use factory/site verification itself as ontology.
